import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/work')
import numpy as np, robot
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point
import geom, percept, slotfind

obs = current()
ARM = "left"
# ---- measure the bank from the head view (fresh, current observation) ----
head = obs.camera("head")
pw, _ = percept.mask_points_world(head, np.asarray(head.K,float), np.asarray(head.depth_m,float), geom.pink_mask(np.asarray(head.rgb)))
sel = (pw[:,0] < -0.24) & (pw[:,1] < -0.09) & (pw[:,2] > 0.80) & (pw[:,2] < 0.93)
P = pw[sel]
cx, cy = float(np.median(P[:,0])), float(np.median(P[:,1]))
zt = float(np.percentile(P[:,2], 99.0))
aim = np.array([cx, cy, zt])
print("bank aim", np.round(aim,4), "n", len(P))

# ---- compute a look pose: camera 0.20 m above the bank, looking at it ----
def frame(a, j):
    a = np.asarray(a,float); a /= np.linalg.norm(a)
    j = np.asarray(j,float); j = j - a*np.dot(a,j); j /= np.linalg.norm(j)
    z = np.cross(a,j)
    return a, j, z

def look_pose(aim, pitch_deg, jaw, dist):
    th = np.radians(pitch_deg)
    a, j, zl = frame(np.array([0.0, np.cos(th), -np.sin(th)]), jaw)
    camdir = 0.87*a - 0.5*zl; camdir /= np.linalg.norm(camdir)
    cam = aim - dist*camdir
    link6 = cam - geom.CAM_FWD*a - geom.CAM_UP*zl
    return link6, a, j, zl, cam, camdir

link6, a, j, zl, cam, camdir = look_pose(aim, 45, (-1,0,0), 0.20)
print("link6", np.round(link6,4), "cam", np.round(cam,4), "camdir", np.round(camdir,4))
q_axes = Rotation.from_matrix(np.column_stack([a,j,zl])).as_quat()
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(link6,"world"),
                                        approach=Direction(a,"world"),
                                        jaw_line=Direction(j,"world"),
                                        interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("move:", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff("look move failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)

# ---- re-measure: where is the gripper now, and is the bank's top in the wrist view? ----
obs2 = current()
p_now = obs2.pose(ARM)
miss = float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(p_now.xyz,float) - link6))
print("link6 now", np.round(np.asarray(p_now.xyz,float),4), "miss_m", round(miss,4))
cam_pred, dir_pred = geom.wrist_cam_pred(p_now)
print("wrist cam predicted", np.round(cam_pred,4), np.round(dir_pred,4))
clusters, counts, zmap, pm = slotfind.find_slot("left_wrist", obs2)
print("pink/dark/drop counts", counts)
for cl in clusters[:10]:
    print(cl)
handoff("look done", clusters=clusters[:10], miss_m=miss)

"""Find a coin slot on the piggy bank in a wrist RGB-D view."""
import numpy as np
from skimage import measure
from ora_lib import geometry
import geom, percept


def find_slot(camname, obs=None, dark_sum=260, depth_drop_m=0.006, min_px=12):
    obs = obs or __import__("ora_lib").current()
    c, K, rgb, dep = percept.cam_arrays(camname, obs)
    M = percept.cam_to_world(c)
    pm = geom.pink_mask(rgb)
    pm = measure.binary_closing(pm, np.ones((3, 3)))
    filled = measure.label(pm)
    if filled.max() > 1:
        sizes = np.bincount(filled.ravel()); sizes[0] = 0
        pm = filled == sizes.argmax()
    H, W = pm.shape
    # world z for every pixel with valid depth
    zmap = np.full((H, W), np.nan)
    ys, xs = np.nonzero(np.isfinite(dep) & (dep > 1e-6))
    xyzc = geometry.back_project(np.stack([xs, ys], axis=1).astype(float), dep[ys, xs], K)
    pw = geometry.transform_points(np.asarray(xyzc, float), M)
    zmap[ys, xs] = pw[:, 2]
    inside = geometry.dilate_disc(pm, 4) & ~pm
    bright = rgb.astype(int).sum(axis=2)
    dark = (bright < dark_sum) & inside & np.isfinite(zmap)
    # local pink surface z (median in a window) for depth-drop test
    from scipy import ndimage
    zpink = np.where(pm & np.isfinite(zmap), zmap, np.nan)
    med = ndimage.generic_filter(np.nan_to_num(zpink, nan=0.0), np.nanmedian, size=21)
    cnt = ndimage.uniform_filter((pm & np.isfinite(zmap)).astype(float), size=21)
    surf = np.where(cnt > 0.05, med / np.maximum(cnt, 1e-6), np.nan)
    drop = inside & np.isfinite(zmap) & np.isfinite(surf) & ((surf - zmap) > depth_drop_m)
    out = []
    for name, mask in [("dark", dark), ("drop", drop), ("dark|drop", dark | drop)]:
        lbl = measure.label(mask)
        for i in range(1, lbl.max() + 1):
            m = lbl == i
            n = int(m.sum())
            if n < min_px:
                continue
            yy, xx = np.nonzero(m)
            pts = pw[np.isin(ys, yy)] if False else None
            # world pts of this cluster
            xyzc2 = geometry.back_project(np.stack([xx, yy], axis=1).astype(float), dep[yy, xx], K)
            pwc = geometry.transform_points(np.asarray(xyzc2, float), M)
            ctr = pwc.mean(axis=0)
            ev = None
            if n >= 8:
                q = pwc - pwc.mean(axis=0)
                w, v = np.linalg.eigh(q.T @ q / n)
                ev = (np.sqrt(w).tolist(), v[:, 2].tolist())
            out.append(dict(kind=name, npx=n, bbox=[int(xx.min()), int(yy.min()), int(xx.max()), int(yy.max())],
                            centre=np.round(ctr, 4).tolist(), ext=(np.round(pwc.max(0) - pwc.min(0), 4).tolist()),
                            axes=ev))
    out.sort(key=lambda d: -d["npx"])
    return out, (pm.sum(), int(dark.sum()), int(drop.sum())), zmap, pm

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/work')
import numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point, geometry
import geom, percept

ARM = "left"
TOL_M = 0.01

def axes_quat(a, j):
    a = np.asarray(a,float); a/=np.linalg.norm(a)
    j = np.asarray(j,float); j = j-a*np.dot(a,j); j/=np.linalg.norm(j)
    return Rotation.from_matrix(np.column_stack([a,j,np.cross(a,j)])).as_quat(), a, j, np.cross(a,j)

def opening(obs, arm=ARM):
    return float(obs.robot_facts["end_effectors"][arm]["gripper"]["measured_opening_normalized"])

# ---------------- measure the coin in the current left_wrist view ----------------
obs = current()
cw = obs.camera("left_wrist")
K, rgb, dep = np.asarray(cw.K,float), np.asarray(cw.rgb), np.asarray(cw.depth_m,float)
M = percept.cam_to_world(cw)
roi = np.zeros(dep.shape, bool); roi[190:310, 260:380] = True
pw, uv = percept.mask_points_world(cw, K, dep, roi)
P = pw[pw[:,2] > 0.7800]
if len(P) < 100:
    handoff("coin face not measured", n=len(P))
c = P.mean(0); q = P - c; w, V = np.linalg.eigh(q.T@q/len(P))
for _ in range(5):
    n = V[:,0]; d = (P - c) @ n
    keep = np.abs(d) < 0.0015
    Pk = P[keep]; c = Pk.mean(0)
    q = Pk - c
    w, V = np.linalg.eigh(q.T@q/len(Pk))
n = V[:,0] * np.sign(V[2,0])          # face normal, upward-ish component
coin_top = float(pw[:,2].max())
coin_xy = np.array([c[0], c[1]])
print("coin face: n=", np.round(n,4), "centre=", np.round(c,4), "inliers", int(keep.sum()),
      "inplane_ext", np.round(2*np.sqrt(w[1:]),4), "top", round(coin_top,4))

# ---------------- grasp poses ----------------
a = np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0])
j = n - a*np.dot(a,n)
Qg, a, j, zl = axes_quat(a, j)
flange_z = coin_top + 0.145
grasp_p = np.array([coin_xy[0], coin_xy[1], flange_z])
pre_p = grasp_p + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.06])
print("grasp flange", np.round(grasp_p,4), "jaw", np.round(j,4))

def go(p, q, interaction, speed, slow=False):
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(p,"world"), orientation=q.tolist(), interaction=interaction)},
                        speed=speed, slow_approaching=slow)
    print(f"move {interaction} -> {np.round(p,4)}: {r.status} ok={r.ok} err={r.target_error_m}")
    return r

r = go(pre_p, Qg, "free_space", "normal")
if not r.ok: handoff("pregrasp failed", failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
r = go(grasp_p, Qg, "precision", "normal", slow=True)
if not r.ok: handoff("grasp move failed", failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
obs = current()
p_now = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyz, float)
print("flange now", np.round(p_now,4), "miss", round(float(np.linalg.norm(p_now-grasp_p)),5))

# ---------------- close the jaws (rate limited) ----------------
prev = opening(obs)
for i in range(6):
    r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "close"})
    obs = current()
    o = opening(obs)
    print(f"close {i}: status={r.status} ok={r.ok} opening={o:.4f} prev={prev:.4f}")
    if abs(o - prev) < 0.005:
        break
    prev = o
held_open = opening(current())

# ---------------- lift ----------------
lift_p = grasp_p + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.09])
r = go(lift_p, Qg, "precision", "normal")
if not r.ok: handoff("lift failed", failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)

obs = current()
p_now = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyz, float)
lift_miss = float(np.linalg.norm(p_now-lift_p))
# verify: coin gone from its table spot (head view)
h = obs.camera("head"); Kh, deph = np.asarray(h.K,float), np.asarray(h.depth_m,float)
pwh, uvh = percept.mask_points_world(h, Kh, deph, np.ones_like(deph,bool))
near = np.linalg.norm(pwh[:,:2] - coin_xy[None,:], axis=1) < 0.018
above = near & (pwh[:,2] > 0.775)
n_left = int(above.sum())
print("head: points above 0.775 near coin spot:", n_left)
# coin at the gripper? distance from the flange along the approach
cw2 = obs.camera("left_wrist")
Kw, depw = np.asarray(cw2.K,float), np.asarray(cw2.depth_m,float)
pww, uww = percept.mask_points_world(cw2, Kw, depw, np.ones_like(depw,bool))
goal = p_now + a*0.1501
dnear = np.linalg.norm(pww - goal[None,:], axis=1) < 0.022
print("wrist: cloud points within 22mm of the pad centre:", int(dnear.sum()),
      "z range", (round(float(pww[dnear][:,2].min()),4), round(float(pww[dnear][:,2].max()),4)) if dnear.sum() else None)
handoff("grasp attempt done", coin_xy=coin_xy.tolist(), held_open=held_open, miss=lift_miss, coin_left=n_left)

p='/work/grasp1.py'
s=open(p).read()
s = s.replace("A_DIR, J_DIR = a, j

A_DIR = None
J_DIR = None
", "A_DIR, J_DIR = a, j
")
open(p,'w').write(s)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/work')
import numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point
import geom, percept

ARM = "left"

def grip_axes(obs, arm=ARM):
    ef = obs.robot_facts["end_effectors"][arm]
    return (np.asarray(ef["axes"]["approach_world"], float),
            np.asarray(ef["axes"]["closing_world"], float))

def coin_centre_head(obs, pad_c, jaw, radius_lim=0.028):
    h = obs.camera("head"); K, rgb, dep = np.asarray(h.K,float), np.asarray(h.rgb), np.asarray(h.depth_m,float)
    pwv, uvv = percept.mask_points_world(h, K, dep, np.ones_like(dep,bool))
    near = np.linalg.norm(pwv - pad_c[None,:], axis=1) < radius_lim
    idx = np.nonzero(near)[0]
    us = uvv[idx].astype(int)
    cols = rgb[us[:,1], us[:,0]].astype(int)
    s = cols.sum(1)
    coin = (cols[:,0] > 90) & (cols[:,0] - cols[:,2] > 40) & (s > 150)
    P = pwv[idx][coin]
    if len(P) < 10:
        return None, len(P)
    slab = np.abs((P - pad_c[None,:]) @ jaw) < 0.003
    P = P[slab]
    return (P.mean(0) if len(P) >= 8 else None), len(P)

obs = current()
p_g = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyz, float)
a_w, j_w = grip_axes(obs)
pad_c = p_g + 0.1501*a_w
th_j = np.arctan2(j_w[1], j_w[0])
target_th = np.pi/2.0
delta_deg = (target_th - th_j) * 180/np.pi
if delta_deg > 90: delta_deg -= 180
if delta_deg < -90: delta_deg += 180
# positive rotation is right-hand rule about local +X = approach axis (a_w)
roll = -delta_deg
print(f"jaw azimuth {np.degrees(th_j):.2f} deg; want {np.degrees(target_th):.0f}; roll command {roll:.2f} deg")

r = tools.rotate_wrist(targets={ARM: float(round(roll, 2))})
print("rotate:", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code)
if not r.ok: handoff("wrist rotation failed", failure=r.failure_code)

obs = current()
p_g = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyz, float)
a_w, j_w = grip_axes(obs)
pad_c = p_g + 0.1501*a_w
print("after: flange", np.round(p_g,4), "approach", np.round(a_w,4), "jaw", np.round(j_w,4),
      "jaw azimuth", round(float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(j_w[1], j_w[0]))),2))
c_head, n_h = coin_centre_head(obs, pad_c, j_w)
print("coin centre (head silhouette):", None if c_head is None else np.round(c_head,4), "pts", n_h)
cw = obs.camera("left_wrist"); Kw, depw = np.asarray(cw.K,float), np.asarray(cw.depth_m,float)
pww, uww = percept.mask_points_world(cw, Kw, depw, np.ones_like(depw,bool))
dnear = np.linalg.norm(pww - pad_c[None,:], axis=1) < 0.026
sl = np.abs((pww - pad_c[None,:]) @ j_w) < 0.003
Q = pww[dnear & sl]
print("wrist slab pts", len(Q), "z max", round(float(Q[:,2].max()),4) if len(Q) else None,
      "x range", (round(float(Q[:,0].min()),4), round(float(Q[:,0].max()),4)) if len(Q) else None)
handoff("aligned", centre=(None if c_head is None else c_head.tolist()), npts=n_h)

"""Locate the coin slot on the piggy bank from a left_wrist RGB-D view."""
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
from skimage import measure
from ora_lib import geometry
import geom, percept


def find_slot(obs, camname="left_wrist", dark_sum=300, ring_px=15, min_px=30):
    c = obs.camera(camname)
    K, rgb, dep = np.asarray(c.K, float), np.asarray(c.rgb), np.asarray(c.depth_m, float)
    M = percept.cam_to_world(c)
    pink = geom.pink_mask(rgb)
    pink = ndimage.binary_closing(pink, np.ones((3, 3)))
    lbl = measure.label(pink); sz = np.bincount(lbl.ravel()); sz[0] = 0
    if sz.max() == 0:
        return None
    pink = lbl == sz.argmax()
    bright = rgb.astype(int).sum(axis=2)
    inner = ndimage.binary_dilation(pink, np.ones((9, 9)))
    dark = (bright < dark_sum) & inner & np.isfinite(dep) & (dep > 1e-6)
    lbl = measure.label(dark)
    best = None
    for i in range(1, lbl.max() + 1):
        m = lbl == i; n = int(m.sum())
        if n < min_px:
            continue
        ring = ndimage.binary_dilation(m, np.ones((ring_px, ring_px))) & ~m
        frac = float(pink[ring].mean())
        if frac > 0.55 and (best is None or n > best[1]):
            best = (i, n, frac)
    if best is None:
        return None
    m = lbl == best[0]
    ys, xs = np.nonzero(m)
    near = ndimage.binary_dilation(m, np.ones((61, 61))) & pink & np.isfinite(dep) & (dep > 1e-6)
    ysp, xsp = np.nonzero(near)
    pw = percept.mask_points_world(c, K, dep, near)[0]
    A = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(pw)), pw[:, 0], pw[:, 1], pw[:, 0]**2, pw[:, 0]*pw[:, 1], pw[:, 1]**2])
    coef, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, pw[:, 2], rcond=None)
    def surf_z(x, y):
        return coef[0] + coef[1]*x + coef[2]*y + coef[3]*x*x + coef[4]*x*y + coef[5]*y*y
    pix = np.stack([xs, ys], 1).astype(float)
    rays = np.stack([(pix[:, 0]-K[0, 2])/K[0, 0], (pix[:, 1]-K[1, 2])/K[1, 1], np.ones(len(pix))], 1)
    Rw = M[:3, :3]; C = M[:3, 3]
    rw = rays @ Rw.T
    rw /= np.linalg.norm(rw, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    t = ((np.median(pw[:, 2]) - C[2]) / rw[:, 2])
    for _ in range(40):
        p = C[None, :] + t[:, None]*rw
        t = (surf_z(p[:, 0], p[:, 1]) - C[2]) / rw[:, 2]
        p = C[None, :] + t[:, None]*rw
    pts = p
    ctr = pts.mean(0)
    q = pts - ctr
    w, V = np.linalg.eigh(q.T @ q / len(q))
    long_axis = V[:, 2]
    nrm = np.array([-coef[1]-2*coef[3]*ctr[0]-coef[4]*ctr[1],
                    -coef[2]-coef[4]*ctr[0]-2*coef[5]*ctr[1], 1.0])
    nrm /= np.linalg.norm(nrm)
    lw = np.sqrt(w)
    return dict(centre=ctr, long_axis=long_axis, normal=nrm, npx=int(best[1]), ring_frac=best[2],
                ext_long=float(2*np.sqrt(3)*lw[2]), ext_short=float(2*np.sqrt(3)*lw[0]),
                azimuth_deg=float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(long_axis[1], long_axis[0])) % 180),
                bbox=[int(xs.min()), int(ys.min()), int(xs.max()), int(ys.max())])

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/work')
import numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point
import geom, percept

ARM = "left"
EPS = 0.005          # how deep the coin's bottom rim should go below the slot plane
STEP_ABOVE = 0.005   # first stop: bottom rim this far above the slot plane
TOR_Z = 0.0025

obs = current()
p_g = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyz, float)
a_w = np.asarray(obs.robot_facts["end_effectors"][ARM]["axes"]["approach_world"], float)
j_w = np.asarray(obs.robot_facts["end_effectors"][ARM]["axes"]["closing_world"], float)
pad_c = p_g + 0.1501*a_w

def coin_points(obs, z_min):
    h = obs.camera("head"); K, rgb, dep = np.asarray(h.K,float), np.asarray(h.rgb), np.asarray(h.depth_m,float)
    pwv, uvv = percept.mask_points_world(h, K, dep, np.ones_like(dep,bool))
    near = np.linalg.norm(pwv - pad_c[None,:], axis=1) < 0.030
    idx = np.nonzero(near)[0]
    us = uvv[idx].astype(int)
    cols = rgb[us[:,1], us[:,0]].astype(int)
    s = cols.sum(1)
    col = (cols[:,0] > 90) & (cols[:,0]-cols[:,2] > 40) & (s > 150)
    P = pwv[idx][col]
    slab = np.abs((P - pad_c[None,:]) @ j_w) < 0.0035
    P = P[slab & (P[:,2] > z_min)]
    return P

# coin bottom measured at the hover height
P = coin_points(obs, 0.900)
if len(P) < 15:
    handoff("coin bottom not measured", n=len(P))
zb = P[:,2].min()
Pb = P[P[:,2] < zb + 0.0025]
coin_bottom = np.array([Pb[:,0].mean(), Pb[:,1].mean(), zb])
print("coin bottom at hover:", np.round(coin_bottom,4), "from", len(Pb), "of", len(P), "pts")

slot_c = np.array([-0.3769, -0.1731, 0.8764])   # clean measurement (unobstructed view)
goal = np.array([slot_c[0], slot_c[1], slot_c[2] - EPS])
print("goal coin bottom:", np.round(goal,4))

def shift(dz, bottom_target):
    d = np.array([bottom_target[0]-coin_bottom[0], bottom_target[1]-coin_bottom[1],
                  bottom_target[2]-coin_bottom[2] + dz])
    return d

# step 1: coin bottom 5 mm above the slot plane
p1 = p_g + shift(0.0, np.array([goal[0], goal[1], slot_c[2] + STEP_ABOVE]))
print("step1 flange target", np.round(p1,4))
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(p1,"world"), approach=Direction(a_w,"world"),
                                         jaw_line=Direction(j_w,"world"), interaction="precision")},
                    speed="normal", slow_approaching=True)
print("step1:", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff("descent step1 failed", failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m, cut=getattr(r,'cut_short',None))

obs = current()
p_g = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyz, float)
P = coin_points(obs, slot_c[2] - 0.005)
zb2 = P[:,2].min() if len(P) else None
print("after step1: flange", np.round(p_g,4), "miss", round(float(np.linalg.norm(p_g-p1)),5),
      "coin bottom z", None if zb2 is None else round(float(zb2),4), "pts", len(P))
err_z = None if zb2 is None else float(zb2 - (slot_c[2]+STEP_ABOVE))
print("bottom z error vs expected:", err_z)
handoff("descended to 5mm above slot", bottom_z=zb2, err_z=err_z, flange=p_g.tolist())

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/work')
import numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point
import geom, percept

ARM = "left"
def grip(obs):
    ef = obs.robot_facts["end_effectors"][ARM]
    return (np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyz, float),
            np.asarray(ef["axes"]["approach_world"], float),
            np.asarray(ef["axes"]["closing_world"], float),
            float(ef["gripper"]["measured_opening_normalized"]))

def go(p, a, j, interaction, speed, slow=False):
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(p,"world"), approach=Direction(a,"world"),
                                             jaw_line=Direction(j,"world"), interaction=interaction)},
                        speed=speed, slow_approaching=slow)
    print(f"  move->{np.round(p,4)}: {r.status} ok={r.ok} failure={r.failure_code} err={r.target_error_m}")
    return r

obs = current()
p0, a_w, j_w, op = grip(obs)
print("start flange", np.round(p0,4), "opening", op)
# two 5 mm insertion steps straight down
for k in range(2):
    p = np.asarray(current().pose(ARM).xyz, float) + np.array([0.0, 0.0, -0.005])
    r = go(p, a_w, j_w, "precision", "careful")
    if not r.ok:
        handoff("insertion step failed", step=k, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m, summary=r.summary)
obs = current()
p1, a_w, j_w, op = grip(obs)
print("after insertion flange", np.round(p1,4), "opening", op)

# open the jaws until released
for i in range(4):
    r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "open"})
    obs = current()
    o = grip(obs)[3]
    print(f"  open {i}: {r.status} ok={r.ok} opening={o:.4f}")
    if o > 0.75:
        break

# retract
obs = current()
p2 = np.asarray(obs.pose(ARM).xyz, float) + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.07])
r = go(p2, a_w, j_w, "free_space", "normal")
if not r.ok:
    handoff("retract failed", failure=r.failure_code)

# ---- verify ----
obs = current()
p3, a_w, j_w, op = grip(obs)
print("final flange", np.round(p3,4), "opening", round(op,3))
cw = obs.camera("left_wrist"); Kw, depw = np.asarray(cw.K,float), np.asarray(cw.depth_m,float)
rgbw = np.asarray(cw.rgb)
pww, uww = percept.mask_points_world(cw, Kw, depw, np.ones_like(depw,bool))
gold = np.zeros(depw.shape, bool)
r_,g_,b_ = rgbw[...,0].astype(int), rgbw[...,1].astype(int), rgbw[...,2].astype(int)
gold = (b_ < 0.62*g_) & (r_ > 90) & (r_-b_ > 40) & (r_+g_+b_ > 150)
pgg, ugg = percept.mask_points_world(cw, Kw, depw, gold)
pad_c = p3 + 0.1501*a_w
d = np.linalg.norm(pgg - pad_c[None,:], axis=1) if len(pgg) else np.array([])
print("wrist gold pts:", int(gold.sum()), "within 25mm of pad centre:", int((d < 0.025).sum()) if len(d) else 0)
# table check from head
h = obs.camera("head"); Kh, deph = np.asarray(h.K,float), np.asarray(h.depth_m,float)
rgbh = np.asarray(h.rgb)
pwh, uvh = percept.mask_points_world(h, Kh, deph, np.ones_like(deph,bool))
rh,gh,bh = rgbh[...,0].astype(int), rgbh[...,1].astype(int), rgbh[...,2].astype(int)
goldh = np.zeros(deph.shape, bool)
